mapper.sql: select a.studio_application_id,a.mentor_id,mu.nick_name mentor_name,a.room_id,r.room_name,r.location, (select count(1) from gw_workstation w where w.room_id=a.room_id and w.deleted_at is null) workstation_count, a.reason,a.status,a.admin_comment,a.reviewer_id,ru.nick_name reviewer_name,a.reviewed_time,a.create_time from gw_studio_application a left join sys_user mu on mu.user_id=a.mentor_id left join gw_room r on r.room_id=a.room_id left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id=a.reviewer_id
mapper.select: select count(1) from gw_studio_application where status='PENDING' and (room_id=#{roomId} or (mentor_id=#{mentorId} and room_id=#{roomId}))
mapper.update: update gw_studio_application set status=#{status},admin_comment=#{comment},reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},reviewed_time=now(),update_time=now() where studio_application_id=#{studioApplicationId} and status='PENDING'

update gw_studio_application set status='RETURNED',admin_comment=concat(ifnull(admin_comment,''),'；解除归属：',#{comment}), reviewer_id=#{reviewerId},reviewed_time=now(),update_time=now() where room_id=#{roomId} and mentor_id=#{mentorId} and status='APPROVED'
